metrics: paired exact fixes/harms for weak atomic families
evaluation_contract.mode: One prospectively frozen decoding condition applied identically to control and treatment. same LoRA, optimizer, LR, context, seed, token cap, runtime cap, decoder, scorer, evaluation cohort, output isolation and checkpoint cadence
